newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV says to build on 96 result in 97.
newsitem.headline: OMV says to build on 96 result in 97.

text.p: Austrian oil and chemicals group OMV AG expects to build on last year's record earnings in 1997, chief executive Richard Schenz said on Wednesday.
"Based on our budget projections...we will manage to enhance our 1996 result in 1997," Schenz told reporters.
The firm's earnings forecast was based on a Brent crude oil price of $17.50 a barrel and a dollar exchange rate of 10.5 schillings. "We have been very conservative in our assumptions," Schenz said.
Earlier OMV reported a 39 percent jump in its preliminary 1996 pre-tax profit to a record 2.9 billion schillings.
